scope: 일반 대화6감정; 작업/독서 전용 pose 경로와 게임 연결 코드 미수정

neutral.changes: 현재 V2 일반대사 디자인과 소품을 보존하며 고해상도 전신 정면시선으로 재제작
neutral.visual_review: 정면 양눈·감정 구분·전신/소품 보존 확인; 밝은 배경 투명 가장자리는 root 독립 검수

joy.prompt:
Edit ONLY facial emotion of image ONE (approved new neutral). Output ONE independent full-body portrait 1024 x 1536 transparent PNG, NOT a sheet. First image controls exact full-body framing, all hair/ear/horn shapes, clothing, body pose, hand positions and props. Keep the entire body and both feet in frame with same margins. Use image TWO only as the face-emotion guide, do not copy its body pose or shift, close or remove any book/lantern/keys. BOTH eyes must remain OPEN and both pupils look directly out toward the viewer/camera/father, never sideways or down at props. Same original character age/species/sex presentation/colors. Faithful chunky pixel game art, thick dark stepped outlines, flat color regions and 2-3 hard shadow tones. No smooth vector outlines, no airbrush, no 3D. No white border or sticker, no text, no symbols, no background, no haze or exterior shadow; fully empty alpha zero outside silhouette.
Warm pleased expression: eyebrows gently lifted, cheeks slightly rosy, small happy mouth smile; BOTH dark eyes stay open and make direct camera eye contact. Keep green lantern and thin brown lighting tool and orange scarf exactly in neutral positions.
joy.visual_review: 정면 양눈·감정 구분·전신/소품 보존 확인; 밝은 배경 투명 가장자리는 root 독립 검수
